subject: HealthSync security follow-up: BAA availability & deployment options
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@healthsync.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: BAA availability & deployment options

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Compliance posture: you asked about SOC 2 and GDPR/HIPAA readiness. Our SOC 2 Type II is currently in progress (expected completion Q4 2026); we can share interim pended evidence once available. We support GDPR controls and data subject request flows.

2) BAA: Redwood offers a standard BAA for customers handling PHI. I attached a draft BAA for your legal team's review.

3) PHI handling & eligible deployment modes:
   - Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) — allowed for PHI and recommended for regulated workflows.
   - Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) — supports PHI with contractual protections.
   - Hosted (public API) — not recommended for direct PHI ingest unless data is tokenized/pseudonymized before it reaches Redwood; we can discuss scoped approaches.

4) Security questionnaire: you mentioned a short vendor security questionnaire — please send it over. We'll assign Marcus and Steph to own the answers and return within 3 business days for the initial pass.

Next steps I propose: 
- Elena: share HealthSync security questionnaire + any evidence requested (e.g., current SOC 2 reports you rely on).
- Redwood: Marcus/Steph to return completed questionnaire and updated BAA redlines.
- Schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with your infra/security team to walk deployment options and encryption/KMS specifics.

If that looks right, I can tee up the meeting for Wed/Thu next week.

Thanks,
Priya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs: HealthSync_SecQ_2026.pdf (incoming from Elena later), BAA_Draft_Redwood_2026.docx (attached)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@healthsync.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: security@healthsync.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: BAA availability & deployment options

Thanks, Priya — that matches our notes. A few clarifications: 

- We need to see any interim SOC evidence (control matrix, SOC engagement letter) while Type II is underway.
- For Hosted API, our legal ops insists on explicit guidance on tokenization approaches and where PHI might be redacted. Can you point to documentation or a short runbook?
- Attached is our short security questionnaire (HealthSync_SecQ_2026.pdf). It's ~12 pages; many items will be straight yes/no but there are a handful of evidence asks.

We'll loop in our procurement/legal if the BAA requires redlines after review. Please mark the questionnaire 'confidential' when returning.

Elena
Director, Partnerships | HealthSync
elena@healthsync.com

Attachment: HealthSync_SecQ_2026.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HealthSync security questionnaire + BAA draft — action items

Folks — forwarding HealthSync's questionnaire and their note. High priority for this deal (HS-2026-RED-43). Ask: can you take point on answers + evidence? Targets below.

Action items: 
- Marcus: lead on questionnaire responses, KMS/encryption, and deployment eligibility language. Please confirm whether Dedicated qualifies for PHI out of the box and what the constraints are for Hosted.
- Steph: legal/BAA redline review and propose any standard changes we should accept or escalate.

Deadlines: initial questionnaire return in 3 business days (EOD Fri 09 Oct). BAA redline by Tue 13 Oct if possible.

I attached our draft BAA for quick reference.

Thanks — Priya

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: HealthSync security questionnaire + BAA draft — action items

Thanks Priya — quick answers from an infra/security perspective (summary for the questionnaire and for Elena):

1) SOC 2 status: We are mid-way through a Type II engagement. Expected report completion Q4 2026. We can provide an interim control narrative, SOC engagement letter, and select evidence (control matrices, test traces) under NDA. I'll gather the interim artifacts and link them in the questionnaire response.

2) BAA: Redwood provides a standard BAA that covers processing, breach notification, subcontractor controls, and permitted data flows. Stephanie, please review the attached BAA_Draft_Redwood_2026.docx for any non-standard clauses. From infra side we don't require custom infra controls beyond our standard obligations, but we'll escalate any unusual legal requests.

3) PHI handling & deployment modes (short):
   - Private (customer VPC / on-prem): Fully supported for PHI. Customer controls network/VPC; Redwood control plane can be configured for private connectivity.
   - Dedicated (reserved capacity in Redwood-managed infra): Supported for PHI with contractual assurances and customer-specific tenancy; recommend dedicated KMS keys (we can integrate customer KMS via standard KMS/HSM connectors).
   - Hosted (multi-tenant public API): Not recommended for ingesting raw PHI. If customer tokenizes/pseudonymizes before sending (or uses redaction proxies), hosted becomes feasible for non-identifiable token data.

4) Encryption & KMS: At-rest and in-transit encryption standard. For PHI workloads we recommend customer-managed KMS; we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and bring-your-own-HSM patterns for private deployments.

5) Questionnaire turnaround: I'll draft answers for the technical sections and attach interim artifacts. For legal/contract items, Steph should coordinate on BAA redlines.

Next suggested step: schedule a 30–45m technical session this week to walk network/connectivity, KMS integration, and example deployment diagrams for Private vs Dedicated. Priya — please propose 2 slots and I'll confirm.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
